envVars.name: FS_USERNAME
envVars.description: Your agent username on propSPACE. Auto-created on first run.

envVars.name: FS_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Account password (min 6 chars). Default: 'simmer-wc-bot'. Set a strong value for production bots.

envVars.name: FS_BASE_URL
envVars.description: FunctionSpace engine URL. Default: mech-v0-4 engine (https://fs-engine-api-mech-v0-4.onrender.com).

envVars.name: FS_ROUND
envVars.description: Round to trade, e.g. 'MD3'. Default: auto-detects the highest open round.

envVars.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
envVars.description: Brave Search API key for scripts/enrich_from_web.py (optional — improves pick quality with expert sentiment).

envVars.name: FS_RECIPE_SHAPE
envVars.description: Belief recipe shape: 'multimodal' density recipe (default) or 'normal' Gaussian baseline.

tunables.label: Play-money per trade (3 picks × this = total stake)
